title: Explore verdict
description: The structured output of the explore workflow. The workflow branches on `tag`, so `tag` is a closed enum: a value outside it is not a different answer, it is a malformed one.

tag.description: The call. `easy-call` means the factory may build this unattended. Anything else stops and waits for a person.

shape.description: What kind of change this is. Names the work so a human scanning the ticket queue knows what they are looking at.

one_liner.description: One sentence saying why this tag and not another. This is the line a human reads when the run halts.
